title: fields: a formula cell with no declared result type prints the raw number in monospace, and the datetime cell's date and time have no separator in the copied text
body:
Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — field rendering | 缺项 | P2

Split by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` from objectui#11672 (the 2026-10-06 console dogfood sweep, showcase, framework `ce577ec4`), items 10 (formula) and 16 (datetime cell). Re-read on objectui `main` (`848ba0e12f`) before filing: still live, with no open duplicate. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` (the formula cell about `:2636`–`:2645`; the datetime cell about `:1251`–`:1252`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: two cell renderers in one file format their text by hand.

## What happens

Projects' Budget Remaining (a formula with no declared result type) renders `200000`, unformatted and in monospace, next to a formatted currency column. A datetime cell renders "2026/10/6上午1:42": the gap is only an `ml-2` margin, not text, so the copied and read value has no separator.

## Done when

- An untyped formula's numeric result is formatted as a number. The dev reads whether the formula's inputs give a better type, for example currency.
- The datetime cell's text carries a real separator.
- **Pins:** both cells, in en and zh-CN.
